messages:
amanda (Support): FYI — customer acct_9X7Y reported being charged $23 on invoice inv_2026-03-10-1123 even though their dashboard shows promo credits available (120)

josh (Billing): Can you paste the account id + invoice id? Also any screenshots or timeline would help

amanda (Support): acct_9X7Y, inv_2026-03-10-1123. Screenshot uploaded to ticket. Customer says credits dropped to 0 in a single spike and invoice posted same morning.

josh (Billing): Looking. Quick thought: expiry job vs invoice finalization ordering can bite us, especially with local tz expiries. I'll run a ledger query now.

josh (Billing): running: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" "https://internal-billing/api/v1/ledger?account=acct_9X7Y&from=2026-03-09&to=2026-03-11"```

billing-bot: ledger export ready: s3://billing-exports/ledger-acct_9X7Y-2109876543.csv

kevin (SRE): There's a known race we saw in Feb where auto-apply/free-credit jobs run at 00:00 UTC and invoice finalization runs shortly after. If promo TTL expiry is stored in account local tz we can get inversion.

josh (Billing): Ledger shows these events (UTC): promo_grant at 2026-03-09T23:59:50Z, promo_expire at 2026-03-10T00:00:01Z, usage_charge at 2026-03-10T00:00:03Z. That ordering makes it look like expiry beat the charge, but customer says grant existed earlier.

amanda (Support): Customer says promo expiry was set to Mar 10 00:00 PST. They were in PST.

josh (Billing): Hypothesis: expiry job computes local-midnight then writes expiry event in a separate service that uses UTC semantics; the grant/auto-apply happens in a different pipeline — timing/order differences cause invoice to see zero credits.

kevin (SRE): I'll repro in staging: create a promo with expiry at midnight PST, then fire concurrent usage around the boundary. Repro steps I plan:
1) create promo grant for staging acct
2) set system clock or use timewarp to 2026-03-10T08:59:50Z (00:00 PST)
3) send 10 concurrent generation requests from 2026-03-10T08:59:58Z to 2026-03-10T09:00:10Z

amanda (Support): Meanwhile I'll issue a temporary credit so the customer isn't billed incorrectly. Opening support ticket CS-4211. @josh can you confirm amount to refund/credit?

josh (Billing): Granting manual credit of $23.00 now; holding any automated reversals. I will add ledger note referencing inv_2026-03-10-1123.

billing-bot: manual_credit_grant created id mc_34567 for acct_9X7Y amount 23.00 by josh

amanda (Support): Customer notified and refunded. They asked for a timeline of events; I'll share the ledger CSV.

kevin (SRE): Created an engineering issue INF-2026: ensure promo expiry/grant ordering uses effective_timestamp and that expiry is processed after billing finalization. Assigning to eng-runtime.

josh (Billing): Proposed hotfix: treat promo_expire effective timestamp as local-midnight-1s and schedule expiry job to run after billing finalization window. Need eng review.

amanda (Support): Marking customer ticket CS-4211 as P1 and updating them that we've applied a manual credit and are investigating. :white_check_mark:

josh (Billing): Quick follow-up: telemetry shows the same pattern for 4 other accounts in the last 7 days. Escalating scope.

kevin (SRE): ETA for patch + tests: ~48 hours. Will add regression test around timezone boundaries.

amanda (Support): Will update customer when patch is deployed and close ticket after verification.

josh (Billing): Note on invoice: manual credit applied, refund queued. Adding internal note linking INF-2026 and CS-4211.

billing-bot: ticket CS-4211 updated, status: pending-engineering
